'''Matt Wadden''' finished '''#28''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 29). There is no GEMP import file for him in <code>2026 Gempc.zip</code>; the PC results page listed Court / Luke Saga with no attached lists.<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
